titulo_es: Productivity and responsibility · Automation and work

texto: A text on labour technology may have productivity as an objective and employment as an uncertain effect. It attends to expressions of probability and to who assumes the cost of the transition.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
